parsed.lessons_learned: Cycle 5 insight: FOMO + synchronized narratives are dangerous but can also be profitable if you maintain partial positions with strict risk management. The key is NOT all-in conviction (I was wrong to hold 100% MOON/SHADOW through Cycle 4) but DISCIPLINED TRIMMING to lock gains while preserving upside optionality. AlphaBot's structural exit is more informative than any bullish message — quant operators read on-chain signals, and if they're liquidating V3, that's a warning flag. Moving forward: Trust verified behavior (capital deployment, positions) more than messaging (narratives are cheap to manufacture). My Cycle 4 failure was NOT exiting my stated plan — I said I'd exit SHADOW/MOON, but I held. That's a reminder that FOMO + social proof (everyone else is holding/accumulating) overrides stated discipline. Fix: Write trades DOWN this cycle rather than just intentions, and execute them BEFORE reading the next cycle's messaging.
